bio.b: Sodhi is a bass music DJ from New Delhi who spent his formative years in London; his sets mix grime, bass, hip-hop, afrobeats and dancehall with soundsystem music. He has hosted a monthly show on boxout.fm and in 2022 toured the UK, playing Corsica Studios in London and Celtronic Festival in Derry, then Magnetic Fields.

bio.b: thegreybox is the DJ and producer alias of a Delhi-based graphic designer best known for his work with the online radio station boxout.fm, where he hosted the monthly show HOODVIBES. His DJ sets move from hip-hop and trap into house and club music, and he released 'Beats' in 2019.
